scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:dev: VITE_CAPACITOR_HTTP_DEV=1 CAPACITOR_PACKAGE_MODE=development vite build --mode development && VITE_CAPACITOR_HTTP_DEV=1 CAPACITOR_PACKAGE_MODE=development npx cap sync
scripts.cap:release: CAPACITOR_PACKAGE_MODE=production vite build --mode production && CAPACITOR_PACKAGE_MODE=production npx cap sync
scripts.cap:run:android:dev: npm run cap:dev && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:run:ios:dev: npm run cap:dev && npx cap run ios --configuration Debug
